latest.notes: Avvio can now import a day's commercial log from your traffic system — fetched from its online endpoint or opened from a file — and export its own in the same format. Columns are mapped by name with the aliases traffic systems use, so a Natural Log style export maps itself. Spots match on a new Cart / ISCI field, then advertiser and title. The preview shows exactly what will place, what won't and why, and nothing is written until you import. See TRAFFIC-LOG-FORMAT.md for the full specification.
